name: stremio-nx
description: Independent Stremio-compatible video player for Nintendo Switch homebrew
author: jrgf

scripts.build:nro: bash scripts/build-runtime.sh && npm run build:app && npm run nro && node scripts/verify-nro.mjs
scripts.host-test:unit: esbuild --bundle --loader:.wasm=binary --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outdir=host-test/dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs host-test/http.test.ts host-test/sha1.test.ts host-test/torrent.test.ts host-test/tracker.test.ts host-test/wire.test.ts host-test/metadata.test.ts host-test/pieces.test.ts host-test/engine.test.ts host-test/dht.test.ts host-test/control.test.ts host-test/ui.test.ts host-test/platform.test.ts host-test/addons.test.ts host-test/subtitles.test.ts host-test/http-stream.test.ts && node --test --test-force-exit host-test/dist/*.test.mjs
